arrangement.notes: Arrangement follows an aggressive, club energy profile with modern sample chopping techniques highlighting the experimental variation.

track_roles.bass: supportive low end with chopped bass riffs
track_roles.melody: experimental leading motifs with glitch and roll effects
track_roles.vocal: uses stutter effects for aggressive textures
track_roles.fx: enhancing transitions and experimental sound design

sensei_drum.brief: Generate drum patterns using modern sample chopping techniques such as slicing, stuttering, and glitching aligned with aggressive club energy.

bass_generator.brief: Create bass lines emphasizing chopped and sliced patterns to reinforce the trip hop experimental atmosphere with club energy.

harmony_generator.brief: Provide chordal textures using sample-based stutter and slice effects to add experimental layers in the arrangement.

melody_generator.brief: Design melodic motifs utilizing glitch, roll, and chop sample manipulations fitting the aggressive and experimental mood.

ai_designer.brief: Ensure arrangement sections and energy curves reflect a strong club energy profile with aggressive trip hop character and experimental sample chops.

presetor.brief: Apply effects and presets emphasizing sample chopping methods and aggressive tonality across all sample layers.

songgps.brief: Manage overall song structure with defined sections and energy markers incorporating experimental trip hop traits and modern sample chopping.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Balance the mix to highlight the dynamic energy shifts, ensuring clarity in the sample chopped drum and melodic layers.
